hero.eyebrow: Open-source control room for AI agents
hero.titleSr: Build, run, evaluate and supervise your AI agents. See every step.
hero.subtitle: Gouvra connects the models you choose to the tools you trust, runs every agent in the background and shows each step live — model calls, tool calls, tokens, costs and errors.
hero.visualLabel: Illustration: an execution trace building live, from a model call to a tool call to the answer.

features.title: Everything an agent needs to reach production
features.subtitle: One place to build agents, run them safely, measure them and understand them — for a single developer or a whole team.

agents.title: Versioned agents
agents.body: Instructions, model, tools and limits in one place. Every change is a version you can compare and restore.

traces.title: Live traces
traces.body: Follow each model call and tool call as it happens, with durations, tokens and costs.

tools.title: Safe tools
tools.body: Strict JSON Schema arguments, allow-listed HTTP hosts and an isolated sandbox for code.

evaluations.title: Evaluations
evaluations.body: Suites with exact, regex, schema and LLM-judge graders. Compare two versions before you ship.

costs.title: Honest costs
costs.body: Reported by the provider, estimated from published prices, or marked unavailable — never invented.

teams.title: Built for teams
teams.body: Workspaces, roles, encrypted keys, an audit log and isolation tested on every route.

steps.title: From zero to a traced execution in minutes

connect.title: Connect a model
connect.body: Add DeepSeek, Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible API. The key is encrypted and tested at once.

build.title: Build an agent
build.body: Write its instructions, pick a model and allow only the tools it needs.

run.title: Watch it run
run.body: Launch it and follow its trace live. When something fails, Gouvra tells you why and what to do.

openSource.title: Self-hosted, Apache-2.0, yours
openSource.body: One command starts the whole stack — API, worker, database, queue and interface — with a demo account to explore.

points.data: Your data stays on your servers

cta.title: Take control of your agents
cta.body: Create an account, connect a model and run your first agent today.

footer.tagline: The control room for your AI agents.
